subject: Hosted API pricing — request for approval matrix and committed tiers
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@pioneerdata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing — volume profile and request for commitment options

Hi Ben,

Attached is a 12-month token usage export and a short summary of our forecast. We're evaluating Redwood for both chat and embedding workloads; the bulk of tokens (~70%) are embeddings. Two questions:

1) What committed monthly spend tiers do you offer for hosted per-token billing? We are specifically interested in a 12-month commit with quarterly true-ups.
2) Is there an internal approval path for rate-card deviations? Our procurement team wants an initial delta from public list prices if we commit to a minimum.

We'd like to close commercial terms by the end of November. Attaching usage samples.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Head of AI Ops
Pioneer Data Systems
Attachments: pioneer_usage_samples.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@pioneerdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — volume profile and request for commitment options

Hi Jordan — great to connect. Thanks for the usage file.

Initial thoughts:
- For a 12-month commit with the volumes in your file we can propose a tiered per-token rate with a headline ~12% off list across combined chat+embed usage at a $X/month commit (I'll put exact numbers in the official quote).
- If Pioneer wants a deeper deviation from list (>15%), I will need sign-off from Revenue Ops / Sales Leadership.

Next steps:
- I'll run these numbers into our pricing tool and send a redlined term sheet.
- Marissa — can you confirm the maximum discretionary discount we can authorize for Hosted deals under $200k ARR without a formal committee?

Jordan — timeline looks good; we'll aim for a draft by Monday.

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: redwood_proposed_terms_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing approval matrix for DEAL-4821 (Pioneer) — need guidance

Marissa/Aditya,

Looping you in here to get a firm approval path for Pioneer (DEAL-4821). Brief summary of proposed structure based on their usage sample:

- 12-month commit, quarterly true-ups.
- Commitment band A: $30k/month => list-equivalent per-token rate, ~8% blended discount.
- Band B: $75k/month => 15% blended discount.
- Band C: $150k/month => 20% blended discount + KV-cache priority on embedding hosts (operational concession).

Pioneer indicated they want a single blended % off list for contractual simplicity. My ask: what is the maximum blended discount we can approve without routing to Pricing Committee? Also, any non-standard concessions we should avoid (e.g., custom KV-cache SLAs, extended data retention)?

Why this matters: if we can approve up to 18% here we can close by EOY. Anything above 18% will require a pricing committee review and a finance-side credit analysis.

Attached is the draft term sheet I plan to send Monday (redwood_proposed_terms_v2.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call — otherwise please reply with your greenlight or redlines.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing approval matrix for DEAL-4821 (Pioneer) — need guidance

Ben — thanks for the summary. Approved path below:

- Approve up to 18% blended discount for 12-month commits where ARR between $600k–$1.8M (which aligns with Band B/C range above), subject to:
  * Minimum monthly commit of $62.5k.
  * No custom SLAs or non-standard data-retention beyond default enterprise package.
  * Contract includes an auto-true-up clause and commit-based termination penalty.

If Ben believes Pioneer will push for >18%, escalate to Pricing Committee and include a one-page business case (motions: strategic reference, market expansion, or channel/co-sell). Aditya — FYI for forecasting / revenue recognition.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
